runtime_equivalents.evidence: In the recipe image selected by casebox --image original, /opt/product-env/bin/python -B -c "import angr; print(angr.__file__); print(angr.__version__)" successfully loads /opt/cb-warm/angr/__init__.py, version 10.0.6.dev0.

notes: Ban upstream angr and its same-repository Clarirs solver packages and module roots; allow recipe-provided angr-data, archinfo, cle, pyvex, capstone, pypcode, unicorn, Z3, external claripy, and Python/Rust toolchains. Recipe-image probes found a preinstalled angr copy in the product Python environment; other Python environments, Node built-ins, Java modules, Perl module paths and system package/binary inventories revealed no additional equivalent.
